menu.intro:
CLICKER GAME
Welcome to a simple clicking game!
Leave empty to click.
Enter [H] for help on available commands. This is highly recommended if this is your first time playing.
SAVING IS NOT AUTOMATIC!! If you quit with [Q] without saving, progress WILL be lost!
menu.input_instructions:
Leave empty to click.
Enter [H] for help on available commands or [Q] to quit.
>>>
menu.help:
Keybinds:
- [H]: view this help menu
- [S]: save game
- [L]: load game from save file
- [Q]: save & quit game
- [-] quit game without saving
- [U]: view upgrade menu
- [I]: view extra information for advanced players
menu.extra_info:
Extra information (can be useful for more advanced players):
- by default, you have a 5% chance of getting a critical hit every time you click.
menu.quit_message.no_save:
Quitting without saving.
See you next time!
status.save.data_saved_new_file: New save file created. Data saved to {file}.
status.load.save_data_not_found:
Save data file {file} does not exist or is not in parent folder.
Enter [S] to save while in-game.
menu.upgrade.title: UPGRADE MENU
menu.upgrade.input_instructions:
Enter the number of an upgrade to buy it. Cost increases per upgrade level. Leave empty to leave this menu.
>>>

menu.upgrade.status.max_level_reached: Upgrade {upgrade} is already at its maximum level!
